title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: detention day rates for dry-class containers
content:
## Scope

This rate card gives the detention day rates for a container of the **dry rate class** under each product of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category. Rates are in USD per container per day, one rate for each of the four charge slabs.

## Detention day rates, dry class

| Product | Slab 1 (USD/day) | Slab 2 (USD/day) | Slab 3 (USD/day) | Slab 4 (USD/day) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 65.00 | 110.00 | 165.00 | 230.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 65.00 | 110.00 | 165.00 | 230.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 65.00 | 110.00 | 165.00 | 230.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 65.00 | 110.00 | 165.00 | 230.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 65.00 | 110.00 | 165.00 | 230.00 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 52.00 | 88.00 | 132.00 | 184.00 |

The five products AHL Tariff Free Time, AHL Free Time Extension 3, AHL Free Time Extension 7, AHL Combined Free Time 14 and AHL Combined Free Time 21 share one dry-class detention rate ladder; AHL Contract Free Time 30 has its own, lower ladder.

## Reading the card

**Q: What is the dry-class detention day rate in slab 2 under AHL Combined Free Time 21?**
A: USD 110.00 per container per day.

**Q: What is the dry-class detention rate for a slab 4 day under AHL Contract Free Time 30?**
A: USD 184.00 per container per day, against USD 230.00 under the other five products.

This card states the dry-class detention rate of each slab only; the rate class of a given container and the slab of a given day are decided by the rules that govern them.
